fem.modifications: First-party FEM core, WASM C bridge, serial embedded runtime and classic source-string wrapper.

workers.modifications: First-party workers packaged as classic JavaScript source strings.

ui-foundation.modifications: Copied as first-party source on 2026-08-25; FEA-owned adaptations and owner-approved GPL grant apply to these copies only. Current content is pinned per artifact.

distribution.modifications: First-party policy notices and source-accompanied packaging; exact upstream notices copied unchanged.

gmsh-js.modifications: Upstream tree unmodified. Packaging converts export function buildApi to a classic function, attaches FS/module, combines generated descriptor and core, and splits source strings.

gmsh.license: GPL-2.0-or-later with upstream linking exception; bundled dependencies retain their notices
gmsh.modifications: Unmodified pinned source. Serial static build with OpenCASCADE, Eigen and bundled modules selected by the recorded CMake recipe; no OpenMP/pthreads. Build metadata and diagnostic source paths are normalized without editing upstream sources.

occt.modifications: Unmodified extracted source; serial static toolkits per build script. Extracted source-tree SHA-256 8a8c83a681b95d7741e70d429d9427072cf75c599ef663614772c97c67cef9af.

three.modifications: None. Copy package/build/three.min.js from accompanied upstream package; readable source is package/src/.

emscripten.license: MIT OR NCSA; system libraries retain their licenses and LLVM exceptions
emscripten.modifications: No upstream source modifications. Build recipes specify embedded serial runtimes and emmalloc; libc, C++ and compiler runtime notices are preserved.

emsdk.modifications: Build tool only; compiler executables are not distributed as application runtime.

cgal.modifications: Upstream sources unmodified; first-party bounded array ABIs select exact-construction intersection refinement and constrained isotropic surface remeshing. CGAL rational MP_Float and round-to-nearest-safe intervals; no GMP or MPFR.

boost.modifications: Unmodified headers only. No Boost runtime library linked.

solid-repair.modifications: First-party CGAL-isolating adapter. Linked artifact uses GPL-3.0-or-later distribution terms.
